findings.detail: The adb-vs-Maestro isolation - the load-bearing evidence for the whole amendment - has NO captured artifact. A repo-wide grep for mIsImeShowing / mImeHeight / dumpsys finds them ONLY in prose (charter lines 53/316/361, GREEN.md 52-53, evidence README 18/47). There is no captured `adb shell input text` run, no `dumpsys input_method` output, and no hierarchy dump showing the field holding text with `Send message enabled: true`. The two investigate flows exist but neither has captured output; type-check-enabled.maestro.yaml asserts enabled:true after Maestro inputText, so its absent output is conspicuous. The amendment enshrines the root cause as settled AND removes use-live-chat.ts from WRITE-ALLOWED, so if the adb hypothesis is wrong cycle 2 cannot fix the real bug without another amendment. Fix: capture the adb/IME evidence into the evidence dir, and either evidence the root cause or keep the alternative fix location available.

The web GREEN half of Defect A is unevidenced and the committed evidence cites a file that does not exist. GREEN.md line 28 cites green/web-green-provider-correlation.json; that file is absent (the dir holds only ios-green-manifest.json, ios-green-provider-correlation.json, ios-green.out, web-green.out). No web-green-manifest.json exists anywhere; the web run_id appears nowhere but web-green.out, whose completed:false carries no pass signal (countPlatformsPassed returns completed: passed===3, so a single-platform run is always completed:false). writeManifest writes to the FIXED path EVIDENCE_ROOT/run-manifest.json so the later iOS run overwrote the web pair. The charter's F-4 asserts real web RED->GREEN with 2 completed provider records while TC-2 requires GREEN saved under the evidence dir. Fix: re-run --platforms web and commit its manifest + correlation pair.

The bisect is under-evidenced on both halves: the only artifact is red/android-bisect-reactcompiler-off.out (64 bytes, completed:false, proves nothing); no OFF-run metro log, so RED.md's 'no such error' claim cannot be checked; the bisect produced no manifest. The ON-run log is genuinely committed (android-red-metro.log line 43). Not blocking because the conclusion is corroborated.

Stale text contradicts the amendment: line 90 still says 'Do NOT create these ORI-RN-004-owned files yourself' while the enumerated list includes live-example.maestro.yaml which the amendment added to WRITE-ALLOWED; line 277 still says 'Parallel: none (one lane, one config file)' when the lane now writes three files; DEPENDENCIES still attributes the proof driver to ORI-RN-004 while the amendment takes MODIFY on it, with no amendment bullet recording the transfer.

Scope holds: the amendment commit itself is charter-only; every path in the wider cycle-1 range is WRITE-ALLOWED; app.json is unchanged with reactCompiler:true intact (bisect properly reverted); use-live-chat.ts unchanged; no credential in the diff or evidence.

summary: The amendment is directionally coherent and AC-2 is not weakened; the cycle-1 fix is real and correctly scoped (two changed lines, seam and ORI-AI-001 test untouched, inlining rule independently confirmed against babel-preset-expo@57.0.10). Android RED, web RED and iOS GREEN are genuinely evidenced. Not approved: the load-bearing 'Defect B is NOT a code bug' claim rests entirely on prose with no captured dumpsys/adb/hierarchy artifact, while the amendment enshrines it and closes off use-live-chat.ts; and the web GREEN manifest/correlation pair was overwritten by the iOS run and is cited but absent.
